excerpt: I started a new job with night shifts, so raid nights just stopped working for me.
Honestly the loot system felt fair. I have no complaints there.
We moved raids from Wednesday to Sunday mornings and I have my kid on Sundays.
I liked the people. The content got stale after the second patch.
The guild merged with another one and suddenly I didn't know anyone.
Raids ran until 1 a.m. my time after we got players from other regions. I couldn't keep up.
Our raid lead messaged me privately and said my numbers were low and asked me to practise my rotation.
I wanted to try PvP and the guild was all about raiding.
Exams. I just didn't have the evenings any more.
There was drama between two officers and everybody picked sides.
The schedule went from two nights to four nights a week. That was too much.
I got burned out on the grind, not on the guild.
My friends quit the game, so I didn't have a reason to stay.
We switched to a time zone that didn't fit mine at all.
I tanked for a year and got tired of being blamed for every wipe, but people were mostly nice about it.
They added a mandatory attendance rule, 80% of raids, and I work weekends.
I wanted a smaller guild where I knew everyone.
The new expansion changed my class and I didn't enjoy playing it.
The officer in charge of loot would call me useless in voice every raid, in front of everyone, and the others laughed.
Summer came and I was outside more. Nothing against the guild.
Raid start moved an hour earlier and I'm still commuting at that time.
I left to join my brother's guild.
They wanted us on voice for three-hour sessions. I have a newborn.
I didn't like how loud the voice chat was, but that's a personality thing.
I became an officer myself for a bit and it was stressful.
One member kept whispering insults to me after I beat him in a duel.
The guild started doing progression on weeknights when I have classes.
There was a lot of joking around. Sometimes it went a bit far but I laughed too.
I wanted to focus on crafting and the market.
Our guild master stopped logging in and the guild just faded.
Weekend raids clashed with my football league.
I disagreed with the loot council decisions, so I left.
After I questioned a loot decision the guild master kicked me from Discord, told the guild I was a ninja looter and blocked me.
The schedule was fine, I just wanted a change.
We went to four-hour raids on Friday and Saturday nights. That's when I see my partner.
I moved countries and the server was too laggy from there.
New job, different hours, couldn't make any of the raid times.
I never really felt part of the core group.
They started requiring a pre-raid meeting at 7 which I couldn't make after work.
The officers were strict about performance, but always polite.
